```c
/*******************************************************************************
* McStas instrument: Triple Axis Spectrometer (TAS) - Source to SC1 stage
*
* %D
* Reconstructed TAS instrument implementing the source, source-to-sample leg,
* and Soller collimator SC1 with full parameter set and monitors.
*
* %P
* KF: [1/A] Final wavevector (default 5)
* KI: [1/A] Initial wavevector (default 0)
* QM: [1/A] Momentum transfer (default 0.5)
* EN: [meV] Energy transfer (default 0)
* verbose: [1] Verbose flag (default 1)
* WM: [m] Monochromator width (default 0.233)
* HM: [m] Monochromator height (default 0.197)
* RMH: [m] Monochromator horizontal curvature (default -1)
* RMV: [m] Monochromator vertical curvature (default -1)
* DM: [AA] Monochromator d-spacing (default 1.807)
* NHM: [1] Monochromator segments H (default 15)
* NVM: [1] Monochromator segments V (default 15)
* WA: [m] Analyzer width (default 0.16)
* HA: [m] Analyzer height (default 0.08)
* RAH: [m] Analyzer horizontal curvature (default -1)
* RAV: [m] Analyzer vertical curvature (default -1)
* DA: [AA] Analyzer d-spacing (default 2.087)
* NHA: [1] Analyzer segments H (default 15)
* NVA: [1] Analyzer segments V (default 15)
* L1: [m] Distance source to monochromator (default 2.3)
* ALF1: [min] Collimator 1 divergence H (default 60)
* ALF2: [min] Collimator 2 divergence H (default 60)
* ALF3: [min] Collimator 3 divergence H (default 60)
* ALF4: [min] Collimator 4 divergence H (default 60)
* BET1: [min] Collimator 1 divergence V (default 120)
* BET2: [min] Collimator 2 divergence V (default 120)
* BET3: [min] Collimator 3 divergence V (default 120)
* BET4: [min] Collimator 4 divergence V (default 120)
*
* %L
* <reference/literature>
*
* %BUILD
* %END
*******************************************************************************/

DEFINE INSTRUMENT TAS_Source_SC1(
    KF = 5,
    KI = 0,
    QM = 0.5,
    EN = 0,
    verbose = 1,
    WM = 0.233,
    HM = 0.197,
    RMH = -1,
    RMV = -1,
    DM = 1.807,
    NHM = 15,
    NVM = 15,
    WA = 0.16,
    HA = 0.08,
    RAH = -1,
    RAV = -1,
    DA = 2.087,
    NHA = 15,
    NVA = 15,
    L1 = 2.3,
    ALF1 = 60,
    ALF2 = 60,
    ALF3 = 60,
    ALF4 = 60,
    BET1 = 120,
    BET2 = 120,
    BET3 = 120,
    BET4 = 120
)

DECLARE
%{
  // Structs to mimic machine_hkl and machine_real used in parameter expressions
  struct {
    double l1;
    double ei;
  } machine_hkl;

  struct {
    double a1;
  } machine_real;
%}

INITIALIZE
%{
  machine_hkl.l1 = L1;
  // If KI is 0, define a default incident energy corresponding to ~2.66 A (approx 11.5 meV)
  machine_hkl.ei = (KI > 0 ? 81.81 / (2.66 * 2.66) : 11.5);
  // Monochromator take-off angle approximation for initialization expression
  machine_real.a1 = 30.0; 
%}

TRACE

// 1. Origin / Progress bar
COMPONENT Origin = Progress_bar()
AT [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

// 2. Source
COMPONENT Source = Source_gen(
    radius = 0.10,
    dist = machine_hkl.l1,
    focus_xw = fabs(WM * sin(machine_real.a1 * DEG2RAD)),
    focus_yh = HM,
    E0 = machine_hkl.ei,
    dE = machine_hkl.ei * 0.03,
    I1 = 0.5874e+13,
    T1 = 683.7,
    T2 = 257.7,
    I2 = 2.5099e+13,
    T3 = 16.7,
    I3 = 1.0343e+12
)
AT [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

// Diagnostic Monitor after Source
COMPONENT mon_source_lambda = L_monitor(
    nlam = 100,
    filename = "mon_source_lambda.dat",
    xmin = -0.1, xmax = 0.1,
    ymin = -0.1, ymax = 0.1,
    Lmin = 0.5, Lmax = 10.0,
    restore_neutron = 1
)
AT [0, 0, 0.01] RELATIVE Source

// 3. SC1 (Collimator linear)
COMPONENT SC1 = Collimator_linear(
    xmin = -WM/2, xmax = WM/2,
    ymin = -HM/2, ymax = HM/2,
    length = machine_hkl.l1 / 2,
    divergence = ALF1,
    divergenceV = BET1
)
WHEN (ALF1 && BET1)
AT [0, 0, machine_hkl.l1 / 4] ABSOLUTE
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

// Diagnostic Monitor after SC1 (Wavelength & PSD)
COMPONENT mon_sc1_psd = PSD_monitor(
    filename = "mon_sc1_psd.dat",
    xwidth = WM * 1.5,
    yheight = HM * 1.5,
    nx = 128, ny = 128,
    restore_neutron = 1
)
AT [0, 0, machine_hkl.l1 / 2 + 0.01] RELATIVE SC1

COMPONENT mon_sc1_lambda = L_monitor(
    nlam = 100,
    filename = "mon_sc1_lambda.dat",
    xmin = -WM/2, xmax = WM/2,
    ymin = -HM/2, ymax = HM/2,
    Lmin = 0.5, Lmax = 10.0,
    restore_neutron = 1
)
AT [0, 0, machine_hkl.l1 / 2 + 0.02] RELATIVE SC1

// 4. Guide_out Arm
COMPONENT Guide_out = Arm()
AT [0, 0, machine_hkl.l1 - 0.2] ABSOLUTE
ROTATED [0, 0, 0] ABSOLUTE

END
```
